overview: This page uses a seasonal time-series model (SARIMAX) that learns the autoregressive, moving-average and 24-hour seasonal structure of the hourly demand history.
The model forecasts the next 30 days directly from the seasonal history, so it needs no future lag values.
results_note: SARIMAX was scored on the last 7 days (168 hours) of data that it did not train on.

details.Forecast method: Direct multi-step forecast from the seasonal state

notes: Parameters were estimated on the training window and the state was then updated with the latest 168 hours before forecasting (no refit).
